video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns, Landry Shamet, Jalen Brunson, James Wiseman Postgame Media | November 27, 2026

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's execution and deficit issues
quotes.excerpt: what got us in the deficit is what lost us the game which was execution
quotes.quote: We put ourselves in those positions that we shouldn't, and we didn't execute at a high level today. Again, we found ourselves fighting, fighting, fighting our way back into the game, but at the end of the day, what got us in the deficit is what lost us the game which was execution. It had nothing to do with the last two or three minutes of the game; it was a game-long lack of execution that hurt us.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns says the Knicks loss to the Bucks came down to a game-long lack of execution. He noted that the deficit they dug themselves into was ultimately what cost them the game.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns discusses the team's lack of execution during a postgame media availability.

quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns on his conditioning: I feel like I played a New York Knicks game. You condition your body to be ready for whatever the season or this team needs.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the challenge of playing with Giannis and Damian
quotes.excerpt: one guy has the second most points in a game ever and another guy is a former MVP
quotes.quote: It's a challenge to that as you just said. One guy has the second most points in a game ever and another guy is a former MVP. Again, it goes back to execution. Just execute what we planned coming into the game and doing it for 48 minutes is what is going to get you a win against a great team like them.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns on facing Giannis and Dame: It is a challenge. One guy has the second most points in a game ever and another guy is a former MVP. It goes back to execution.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns discusses the challenge of playing against Giannis Antetokounmpo and Damian Lillard.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the disappointment of not defending the cup
quotes.excerpt: obviously disappointed we can't defend the cup championship but we still have a lot more games
quotes.quote: Obviously disappointed we can't defend the cup championship, but we still have a lot more games to get ourselves ready to defend the world championship. We will continue to get 1% better every single night, continue to lean on each other, sacrifice for each other, and see where we end up at game 83.
quotes.social_post: Karl-Anthony Towns says he is disappointed the Knicks cannot defend their NBA Cup title, but the focus remains on the world championship. We will continue to get 1 percent better every single night.

structured.context: Karl-Anthony Towns reflects on the team's disappointment after failing to defend their NBA Cup championship.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the team's need to minimize poor starts
quotes.excerpt: it was a tough start but you still got to find ways to try to dig yourself out
quotes.quote: There's 82 games and you're going to have nights where it's flowing and clicking and maybe you blow a team out. You're going to have nights on the other end. The job remains the same. It was a tough start, but you still got to find ways to try to dig yourself out of it. I don't look at it as any sort of trend. You want to try to minimize nights like tonight as best you can.
quotes.social_post: Landry Shamet says the Knicks need to minimize poor starts after tonight's loss. He added that he does not look at the slow start as any sort of trend.

structured.context: Landry Shamet discusses the team's need to avoid poor starts during the regular season.

quotes.quote: Maybe a little bit mentally, but physically not that much. I mean we should have been playing that way from the start. So it's something that I think we're comfortable with being able to fight back, but obviously a position we don't want to be in.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Brunson on the Knicks fighting back from deficits: We should have been playing that way from the start. It is something I think we are comfortable with being able to fight back, but obviously a position we do not want to be in.
